issues.reason: Gap mistaken for defect: a verb-modifying extent PP has no licensed slot, and the instruction set's own ruling for unslottable verb modifiers ('a degree adverb on a verb ... have no licensed slot: leave them out and record the gap') licenses dropping it while keeping the clause, since 'distilled at reduced volume' entails 'distilled' and no emitted atom is thereby false or widened.

'Those named roles apply when the PP answers where / when / how / whence / whither ... Decide by the question the PP answers, never by which listed role is closest', and a prepositional verb's argument goes to the preposition-named oblique ('dealt with the appeal', 'referred to the memo' — not Instrument, not Recipient), so 'exempt X from Y', which names no origin, makes (Source sk_exempt_1 salt_bloom) assert a whence relation the sentence does not state.

The half that stands: 'cold' is a gradable descriptive adjective, not one of the four fusing categories (term of art / nationality-origin / role title / material adjective), so the fused kind cold_month is not clearly licensed; the half that falls: nothing false or over-asserted follows, because the parse also emitted the modifier genus (Inheritance cold_month cold), so each member inherits both month and cold exactly as the distributive route would deliver.

A temporal-period NP is not an ordinary oblique object: the Time section keeps seasons and day-parts as bare constants and bars minting an sk_ witness or a Member atom for a time, so the bare constant winter is well-typed — and the reviewer's own q2 gap concedes the instruction set leaves this NP's status undecided.

gaps_confirmed: manner/extent PP on a verbal event ('distilled at reduced volume') — Manner is how-adverbs-of-manner only and the preposition-named oblique is defined for aboutness PPs, so no head is licensed for a PP saying to what degree the action was done

temporal-scope 'for'-phrase over a named period ('standardized the rations for the winter') — neither Beneficiary nor a numbered-duration Measure applies, and the fallback For oblique leaves the period NP's encoding (witness vs bare time constant) undecided
new_gaps: The obliques list glosses Source as bare 'from ...' while the very next sentence restricts the named roles to PPs answering where/when/how/whence/whither; nothing states that a non-whence 'from'-argument of a prepositional verb ('exempt X from Y', 'bar X from Y', 'excuse X from Y') takes the preposition-named (From <event> ...) oblique, and the gloss/test collision invites exactly this mis-slot.

The adjective+noun fusion test names four fusing categories against 'incidental description (colour, size, damage, mood)' but gives no criterion for a conventional period or season designation built on a descriptive adjective ('the cold months', beside the noun-modifier 'the frost weeks') — the choice is declared 'determined, not optional', yet this class falls between the two lists.
defect_summary: The compliant form for 'exempted the Northcove from salt-bloom' is the preposition-named oblique (From sk_exempt_1 salt_bloom) in place of the named role (Source sk_exempt_1 salt_bloom) — the same routing the instruction set gives 'dealt with the appeal' and 'referred to the memo'; a compliant form is licensed, so this is not a no-fix case.
notes: Everything else in this parse is sound: the non-factive report/say seals, the projection of definite typing and compound decomposition out of them, passage coreference on sk_council_1 / hesper / sk_harvest_1, the During for a surface 'during', and the embedded future-shift on 'would yield' are all as specified.
